purpose: Canonical registry for Oshurn OS financial tools and their data boundaries.
principles: Tools are modular applications, not marketing pages.
Shared financial state is the source for cross-tool summaries and trends.
Educational calculations must remain distinguishable from regulated individualized financial services.
Each tool declares inputs, outputs, persistence, and future integration points.

tools.name: Budget Planner
tools.educationBoundary: Descriptive budgeting and planning only; no individualized product recommendation.

tools.name: Debt Payoff Explorer
tools.educationBoundary: Scenario modeling only. Future APR-aware versions must label assumptions and estimated interest.

tools.name: Savings Planning
tools.educationBoundary: Goal pacing only; does not recommend securities or financial products.

tools.name: Net Worth Snapshot
tools.educationBoundary: User-entered balance-sheet organization and descriptive analytics.

tools.name: Financial Health
tools.educationBoundary: Educational financial wellness indicators; not a credit, investment, insurance, tax, or legal determination.

futureModules.name: Debt Strategy Lab
futureModules.note: Must expose assumptions and avoid presenting individualized regulated advice without the required compliance architecture.

futureModules.name: Retirement Education Lab
futureModules.note: Educational scenarios only until an appropriate regulated-advice framework exists.

futureModules.name: Protection Education
futureModules.note: Insurance education can be developed before any quoting, solicitation, recommendation, or transaction capability.

regulatedBoundary.requirement: Future regulated capabilities must use a separate compliance-ready service boundary, authorization model, disclosures, records, and applicable licensing/supervision controls rather than being enabled by the educational client layer.
